name: InsightGoDeeper - PromptFilledTheBox
description: After clicking a go-deeper prompt: the words are IN the box, unsent, with the send control now live. The rule AnswerChips and SuggestionChips already hold, for the same reason - a prompt that submitted would turn 'dig into this' into a menu of two approved questions, when the point of the box is that the person asks their own.
